title: Pocket Mayhem
description: A tiny robot, a toybox full of trouble, and wildly irresponsible upgrades. Survive eight minutes and beat the final boss—or go endless.
controls: WASD, arrow keys, or the thumbstick to move; weapons aim and shoot automatically
Space, Shift, or Dash to dodge and smash through toys
F or Overdrive when charged for a healing blast and boosted weapons
P or Escape to pause; M to toggle sound; 1–3 to choose an upgrade
